_help: Studio-wide details. Used by the home page, the studio contact page and any listing that sets useSiteContact to true. Empty values are hidden on the site. name is the full studio name (titles, hero, footers); shortName is used where space is tight (logo, back buttons). The studio name, tagline and description shown at the top of the home page come from here, not from index.html. heroImage is the home page banner: put the file in media/home/ and write its path, for example media/home/banner.jpg (empty = purple gradient). heroOverlay (0 to 0.9) darkens the picture so the text stays readable; heroPosition says which part stays visible when it is cropped. See media/home/README.md.
